  {"step": 2, "file": "tests/ClientServer/unit_tests/fuzzing/fuzz_decoder.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 33, "var": "type", "code": "SOPC_EncodeableType* type = SOPC_KnownEncodeableTypes[type_index];", "note": "Retrieves the KeyValuePair encodeable type descriptor."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "tests/ClientServer/unit_tests/fuzzing/fuzz_decoder.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 43, "var": "status", "code": "status = SOPC_EncodeableObject_Decode(type, pValue, buffer, 0);", "note": "Decodes the KeyValuePair from attacker-controlled buffer bytes."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_encodeabletype.c", "function": "SOPC_EncodeableObject_Decode", "line": 545, "var": "desc", "code": "const SOPC_EncodeableType_FieldDescriptor* desc = &type->Fields[i];", "note": "Iterates KeyValuePair fields; the Value field is a Variant (isBuiltIn=true, typeIndex=SOPC_Variant_Id=24)."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_encodeabletype.c", "function": "getPfnDecode", "line": 320, "var": "SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable[desc->typeIndex].decode", "code": "return SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable[desc->typeIndex].decode;", "note": "For the Variant field, returns SOPC_Variant_Read as the decode function."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_encoder.c", "function": "SOPC_Variant_Read_Internal", "line": 2640, "var": "encodingByte", "code": "SOPC_Byte_Read(&encodingByte, buf, nestedStructLevel);", "note": "Reads the variant encoding byte 0x9A from input: array flag (0x80) set and builtin type id bits 0x1A."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_encoder.c", "function": "SOPC_Variant_Read_Internal", "line": 2662, "var": "variant->BuiltInTypeId", "code": "variant->BuiltInTypeId = 0x3F & encodingByte;", "note": "Extracts builtin type id 26 (0x1A) from the encoding byte; this is SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX+1."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_encoder.c", "function": "SOPC_Variant_Read_Internal", "line": 2672, "var": "variant->ArrayType", "code": "variant->ArrayType = SOPC_VariantArrayType_Array;", "note": "Array flag set, so the variant is decoded as an array via ReadVariantArrayBuiltInType."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_encoder.c", "function": "ReadVariantArrayBuiltInType", "line": 2545, "var": "builtInTypeId", "code": "else if (builtInTypeId <= 0 || builtInTypeId > SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1)", "note": "Bounds check incorrectly allows builtInTypeId == 26 because it compares against SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX+1 instead of SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_encoder.c", "function": "ReadVariantArrayBuiltInType", "line": 2609, "var": "SOPC_BuiltInType_HandlingTable[26] / SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable[26]", "code": "status = SOPC_Read_Array(buf, length, (void**) &array->BooleanArr, SOPC_BuiltInType_HandlingTable[builtInTypeId].size, SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable[builtInTypeId].decode, ...);", "note": "Out-of-bounds read of the builtintype tables at index 26; tables are sized SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX+1 (indices 0-25), so index 26 is past the end, leading to OOB access and potential crash."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written"` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now let me write the candidate trace. The trace should describe the path from attacker-controlled input through propagation and root cause to the memory-safety sink.

The path:
1. `buf[0]` selects the encodeable type (KeyValuePair) via `buf[0] % SOPC_TypeInternalIndex_SIZE`
2. `SOPC_EncodeableObject_Decode` is called with the KeyValuePair type
3. The `Value` field (Variant) is decoded via `getPfnDecode` -> `SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable[24].decode` = `SOPC_Variant_Read`
4. `SOPC_Variant_Read_Internal` reads the encoding byte, extracts `BuiltInTypeId = 0x3F & encodingByte = 26`
5. Since array flag is set, `ReadVariantArrayBuiltInType` is called with `builtInTypeId = 26`
6. The check `builtInTypeId > SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` allows 26 (since 26 == SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1), but the tables are sized `SOPC_BUILTINID_MAX + 1` = 26 elements (indices 0-25)
7. `SOPC_BuiltInType_HandlingTable[26]` and `SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable[26]` are accessed OOB

Let me write the trace JSON.
